msg.content: Which heads of state of the founding countries of the European Union are older than 80 years old?
Which heads of state of the founding countries of the European Union are older than 80 years old?

content.content:
The user asks: "Which heads of state of the founding countries of the European Union are older than 80 years old?" Need to list founding countries of EU (original six? Or founding members of EU as a whole). The EU founding countries are the six that signed the Treaty of Rome in 1957: Belgium, France, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, West Germany (now Germany). Also earlier the European Coal and Steel Community (ECSC) had also those six. So founding countries: Belgium, France, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Germany. Heads of state: For each country, identify current heads of state (as of now: 2025). Determine their ages, and list those older than 80.

We need current heads of state (presidents, monarchs). Let's list:

- Belgium: King Philippe (born 15 April 1960) age 65 in 2025, not >80.
- France: President Emmanuel Macron (born 21 Dec 1977) age 48, not >80.
- Italy: President Sergio Mattarella (born 23 July 1941) age 84 in 2025, >80. Actually Mattarella turned 84 in July 2025. He is still president? He was re-elected 2022, term ends 2029. So yes.
- Luxembourg: Grand Duke Henri (born 16 April 1955) age 70, not >80.
- Netherlands: King Willem-Alexander (born 27 April 1967) age 58, not >80.
- Germany: President Frank-Walter Steinmeier (born 5 Jan 1956) age 69, not >80.

Thus only Italy's president Sergio Mattarella is >80.

But also note that some countries have both a head of state and a head of government; the question explicitly "heads of state". So answer: Sergio Mattarella.

Check if any other founding countries have had other heads of state older than 80? Could be that Belgium also has a regent? No.

Thus answer: Italy's President Sergio Mattarella, age 84 (born 1941). Provide list.

We should verify ages via quick lookup? Use function delegate to check ages of each.

content.content:
We need current heads of state (monarchs or presidents) for those countries as of 2025. Likely: Belgium: King Philippe (born 1960, age 65 in 2025). France: President Emmanuel Macron (born 1977, age 48). Italy: President Sergio Mattarella? Actually Mattarella's term ended 2022, succeeded by President Sergio Mattarella? Wait: Italy's president as of 2025 likely is President Sergio Mattarella? Actually Mattarella re-elected 2022 for second term ends 2029. So still. Birth date 1941, age 84. Luxembourg: Grand Duke Henri (born 1955, age 70). Netherlands: King Willem-Alexander (born 1967, age 58). Germany: President Frank-Walter Steinmeier (born 1956, age 69). Need confirm ages as of Nov 1, 2025. Compute ages precisely: Age = year diff minus if birthday after Nov 1.

Let's get exact birth dates:

- King Philippe of Belgium: born 15 April 1960. By 1 Nov 2025, he turned 65 on 15 April 2025. Age 65.

- President Emmanuel Macron: born 21 December 1977. By 1 Nov 2025, his birthday hasn't occurred yet (December). So age = 2025-1977 = 48, but not yet turned 48? Actually he turned 47 on 21 Dec 2024, will turn 48 on 21 Dec 2025. So as of 1 Nov 2025, age 47. Wait compute: 2025 - 1977 = 48, but birthday Dec 21 > Nov 1, so still 47. So age 47.

- President Sergio Mattarella: born 23 July 1941. By 1 Nov 2025, he turned 84 on 23 July 2025. Age 84.

- Grand Duke Henri of Luxembourg: born 16 April 1955. Age 70 (turned 70 on 16 April 2025).

- King Willem-Alexander of Netherlands: born 27 April 1967. Age 58 (turned 58 on 27 April 2025).

- President Frank-Walter Steinmeier: born 5 January 1956. Age 69 (turned 69 on 5 Jan 2025).

Double-check if any changes: Germany's president may change after 2022? Frank-Walter Steinmeier was re-elected 2022 for second term until 2027, so still. Italy's president still Mattarella.
